title: az boards work-item create --title ${title} --type ${type} --description ${body} --project ${project}
description: The work item it creates, whose number kit reads in `modules/bash/forge/ado.sh` (forge/ado:issue-create), with no --output, so az prints its default, JSON, and every call through forge/ado:az carrying --org ${organization} --detect false --only-show-errors, and in `modules/bash/tracker/ado.sh` (tracker/ado:create), which runs it with no --description and --org ${organization} --output json. The type is WorkItem, https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/azure/devops/wit/work-items/create?view=azure-devops-rest-7.1.
